title: Ellaz fighter file
description: What a fighter IS, as opposed to what it looks like (the sprite set's manifest) or what it does (that set's moves file). Speeds are VIEW PIXELS PER SECOND at TICK_RATE, because that is the unit a human can reason about; compile.ts turns each into FP per tick, floored, once.

sprites.description: a directory under ../assets/ holding <set>.manifest.json and <set>.moves.json; data.test.ts asserts both exist

speed.description: view px per second, walking along x

zSpeed.description: view px per second, stepping between lanes

xp.description: what a stage pays the hero for this fighter's KO; absent means 0 (a hero)

flying.description: no gravity while alive: the fighter holds `hover` above the floor (a bat). A KO drops it

hover.description: view px above the floor while flying; REQUIRES `flying` - the subset has no if/then, so data.test.ts and compile.ts assert it

drawScale.description: whole multiples of the cell's one draw scale a boss is drawn at (1 to 4); absent is 1; the subset has no maximum, so compile.ts refuses one above 4 - and a fighter's hitboxes grow with its picture, so a big boss is hit where it is drawn

boss.description: a level's boss: the HUD draws its bar top-centre while it stands
